content: Lombok 1.18.34 + MapStruct 1.6.3 is a confirmed-working pair with Spring Boot 3.5.x. Because Lombok 1.18.16+, an extra annotation processor dependency org.projectlombok:lombok-mapstruct-binding (0.2.0) is required, and annotation processor order matters: lombok first, mapstruct-processor second, lombok-mapstruct-binding third -- otherwise MapStruct generates mappers before Lombok emits getters/setters.
